messages:
maya (CS): FYI Lightbridge onboarding — they reported a spike of 429s during initial client rollout. ~30% of preflight calls failing when many users open the app at once. Tokens are ephemeral (30s TTL). Can eng weigh in?

arjun (eng-plat): Sounds like a preflight storm + token renewal thundering herd. Most likely cause: every client doing fresh preflight+token at same time, hitting auth/gateway.

maya (CS): They repro by opening 150 tabs in a short window. We see repeated 429 and occasional 401s.

arjun (eng-plat): Quick mitigations: 1) add randomized jitter to client startup (0-250ms). 2) server-side token broker: exchange ephemeral tokens once and share to clients when possible. 3) increase ephemeral TTL by small amount (e.g., +10s) if policy allows. 4) implement exponential backoff with full jitter on preflight.

devon (eng-sre): Also check client TCP/TLS connection reuse. Many clients re-create connections which ramps proxies. If using browser SDK, recommend keepAlive + connection pool. Logs show repeated auth refresh spikes matching the 429 windows. Example from gateway tail:

[2026-03-08T15:12:03Z] INFO auth: token-refresh start client_id=lb-frontend-1
[2026-03-08T15:12:03Z] WARN gateway: 429 preflight rate_limit=120/s path=/v1/preflight src=10.8.0.45
[2026-03-08T15:12:03Z] ERROR auth: token-refresh failed status=429 retries=0 client_id=lb-frontend-1

kevin (support): For Lightbridge's environment we suggested a short rollout change. Here's a minimal JS backoff snippet they can drop into the SDK init: 

```
// init debounce + jitter
const base = 100;
const max = 2000;
function backoffAttempt(n) {
  const jitter = Math.random() * 250;
  return Math.min(max, base * 2 ** n) + jitter;
}
// usage: await wait(backoffAttempt(retryCount));
```

arjun (eng-plat): Additional client config we recommend they try right away: 
- preflightTimeoutMs: 3000
- preflightMaxConcurrent: 5
- startupSplayMs: 0-250
- tokenCacheBufferSec: 10

maya (CS): Can we draft a short checklist I can send them?

arjun (eng-plat): Yes — send this: 
1) Add client startup jitter (0-250ms).
2) Implement exponential backoff + full jitter for preflight calls.
3) Prefer server-side token broker if multiple clients share a session.
4) Enable connection reuse / keepalive on SDK.
5) If acceptable, increase ephemeral token TTL by 10s.
6) Share gateway logs if 429s persist (attach time ranges).

kevin (support): I'll include an annotated packet of instructions and the backoff snippet. Also ask them to toggle one change at a time so we can measure.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Deployed dashboard panel for customer preflight_rate & auth_errors -> https://console.redwood.ai/d/lightbridge/preflight (view only)

maya (CS): Great. I'll send the checklist and ask them to apply jitter + backoff first. Follow-up sync tomorrow EOD. Assigning internal follow-up to @arjun and @devon to monitor logs during rollout. Thanks all :thumbsup:
